thread:
nora: Quick sync - proposing a lightweight "precision-fallback score" attached to quant profiles. Score is an estimated expected quality delta when falling back from a low-bit profile to baseline (e.g., FP16). Helps routing and billing decisions.

sam: How do we compute it? offline eval or runtime estimate?

nora: Both. Start with offline eval on a canonical prompt corpus to seed a prior; update with runtime exponential moving average per-tenant. Keep separate estimates per task-family.

jia: For runtime, we need low-cost signals: degscore proxies and short-window token-level loss. Don't compute heavy evals in the hot path.

ops_kate: Also expose the score in catalog UI and in the API so product teams can opt into automated fallback routing. We need audit logs for any auto-fallback decisions.

quant-ci-bot: Added ticket QCI-332 to track integrations.

nora: Action items: nora -> spec score schema, sam -> offline batch to seed priors, jia -> runtime EMA hook, ops_kate -> UI + audit hooks. Target: prototype in 2 sprints.

sam: sounds good. I'll start the batch job and share results next week.

nora: thanks :thumbsup:
